sources.collection_name: World War II Army Enlistment Records
sources.rights_notes: No raw row or full private identifier is retained. Charles W David, Donald J Davidson and George B Davidson have accepted identifier-and-name matches. Abraham Davidson's printed value selected an Army row under a different full name and is rejected; seven exact-name alternatives are not assigned. David Davidian's eligible printed value had no hit and two exact-name rows remain unassigned. Homer David Jr.'s printed value did not meet the strict eight-digit eligibility rule. The incomplete Army file is not a comprehensive OSS, officer, Navy, Marine Corps, civilian, WAC, Coast Guard, or foreign roster; a non-hit is not negative proof.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index preserves the second of two consecutive Elizabeth Davey rows, neither with rank, middle initial, or private identifier. A Lovell Historical Society article identifies an Elizabeth Davey Velen as a Radcliffe graduate who joined the OSS, but it does not distinguish the index rows or supply a Box 168 bridge. The candidate remains withheld and unassigned.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified. Review both consecutive Elizabeth Davey folders in Box 168 to distinguish the rows and test the Elizabeth Davey Velen lead. Do not treat Radcliffe attendance as employment or her later United Nations career as pre-OSS.
